name: Civil unrest
value: France protests shrink; no deadly unrest
summary: French living-cost protests continue on Saturdays with falling turnout; no deadly nationwide unrest found by 26 Nov
state: About 106,000 people marched across France on 14 Nov in a fifth weekend of living-cost protests, including 24,000 in Paris, by interior ministry count, while student unions claimed 200,000 (Malay Mail, AFP). Later rounds have drawn lower participation (Ara). Significant protests keep Watch; no deadly nationwide unrest or major state crackdown in a large country was found as of 26 Nov.
for_you: Expect local transport disruption around protest routes in French cities on Saturdays; follow FCDO travel advice for France.
rubric_hit: Significant protests in several countries = Watch; no deadly nationwide unrest

sources.title: Malay Mail (AFP) — More than 100,000 march across France as protests enter fifth weekend
Ara — Protests in France continue but record lower participation

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
